meta.name: golang-pro
meta.description: Implements concurrent Go patterns using goroutines and channels, designs and builds microservices with gRPC or REST, optimizes Go application performance with pprof, and enforces idiomatic Go with generics, interfaces, and robust error handling. Use when building Go applications requiring concurrent programming, microservices architecture, or high-performance systems. Invoke for goroutines, channels, Go generics, gRPC integration, CLI tools, benchmarks, or table-driven testing.

copy.tagline: 用 goroutine 和 channel 构建高并发 Go 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Go 开发需要高并发或微服务的项目
copy.tagline_en: Build high-concurrency Go apps with goroutines and channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building Go applications requiring concurrency or microservices

howto.what: Claude 会用 Go 语言编写并发程序和微服务：用 goroutine 和 channel 处理并发，用 gRPC 构建服务，用 pprof 做性能分析；产出代码时附带表驱动测试和文档。
howto.when: 当你要求开发 Go 程序、涉及并发、微服务或高性能系统时触发；提到 goroutine、channel、gRPC 等关键词也会接管。

say.text: 帮我用 Go 写一个 goroutine 池，管理并发任务。
say.note: 会生成带生命周期管理的 worker 代码。

say.text: 用 pprof 分析这个 Go 项目的性能瓶颈。
say.note: 会运行分析并给出优化建议。

say.text: 给这个 Go 函数写表驱动测试。
say.note: 会产出带 -race 的测试代码。

howto.what_en: Claude writes concurrent programs and microservices in Go: uses goroutines and channels for concurrency, builds services with gRPC, profiles with pprof, and includes table-driven tests and documentation in its output.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to develop Go programs involving concurrency, microservices, or high-performance systems; also when keywords like goroutine, channel, gRPC, etc. are mentioned.

say_en.text: Help me write a goroutine pool in Go to manage concurrent tasks.
say_en.note: Generates worker code with lifecycle management.

say_en.text: Use pprof to analyze this Go project's performance bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Runs analysis and gives optimization suggestions.

say_en.text: Write table-driven tests for this Go function.
say_en.note: Produces test code with the -race flag.
